newsitem.title: USA: NEC Computer Systems to make strategy announcment.
newsitem.headline: NEC Computer Systems to make strategy announcment.

text.p: Packard Bell NEC Inc and its NEC Computer Systems unit will make an innovative business strategy announcement Wednesday, industry sources said, saying that NEC may unveil a plan to sell PCs directly to customers.
"As far as I can tell they are trying to switch to a direct model ... but I'm not sure how they are going to implement it," said one industry source.
An NEC spokeswoman declined to comment.

Last week, Computer Reseller News, a trade publication, reported that the NEC Computer Systems Division is considering a plan to pull its desktop and notebook PCs from distributors and begin selling direct to customers in August.

The success of Dell Computer Corp's model of selling PCs directly to end users has lead many companies to look at their current way of selling PCs, from Compaq Computer Corp to Hewlett-Packard Co and now to NEC.

Packard Bell NEC and its NEC Computer Systems unit, which are part of NEC Corp of Japan, have been losing market share in North America, and the move would be an attempt to regain market share and cut the additional distribution costs, sources said.
